1 football player from Eau Claire County, Wisconsin high school committed in August 2026
One football player from a high school in Eau Claire County, Wisconsin is listed by Prep Redzone as having committed to play college football during August 2026.
Owen Gunderson from Altoona High School committed to Augustana University on August 14, 2026.
